stories.headline: Anthropic warns small AI models may self-replicate
stories.summary: Anthropic says experiments suggest small models may be months from spreading across vulnerable consumer devices. Full end-to-end replication still failed under normal test conditions.

stories.headline: Bank watchdogs intensify scrutiny of AI agents
stories.summary: US regulators are asking banks how they constrain, audit and shut down autonomous AI agents. European supervisors are also pressing lenders on recovery plans; no new binding rules were announced.

stories.headline: IMF flags AI-correction, war and debt risks
stories.summary: The IMF lifted its 2026 global-growth forecast to 3.1% but warned that an AI-investment reversal could cut global GDP 1.1% by 2028. Its outlook also assumes Hormuz shipping improves.

stories.headline: Russia says energy-ceasefire contacts continue
stories.summary: The Kremlin says contacts continue over a Russia–Ukraine energy ceasefire announced by President Trump, but did not identify participants. Moscow and Kyiv have not jointly confirmed the arrangement.

stories.headline: Eleven missing after drone sinks ship off Bulgaria
stories.summary: Bulgarian officials say two cargo ships were struck and one sank; five crew were rescued and 11 remained missing. Bulgaria summoned Russia's ambassador but stopped short of assigning responsibility.
